description: Use when the user asks if it is alt season. Returns the SwapHunt Alt Season Index (0-100, daily): share of the top 100 Hyperliquid perpetuals by 30-day volume beating BTC over 90 days; 75 or above is alt season, 25 or below is bitcoin season. Ex: no parameters Free trial: 10 calls a day. More tools (30, paid per call in USDC via x402): run the local server, `uvx swaphunt-mcp`, https://x402.swaphunt.dev/docs
name: get_alt_season
